purpose: Canonical MC-seed manifest for P4 headline figures, closing DeepSeek-B2 deferral from the 2026-05-14 real cross-vendor R-round on P4 v1.0.51.

headline_figures.figure: Wave 12 hemisphere look-elsewhere null at p_LEE <= 1e-4
headline_figures.abstract_role: Direct-MC LEE upper bound at MC resolution floor
headline_figures.method: GPU-accelerated permutation null: per-galaxy CW-label random shuffle, recomputing max-over-direction |A(hat n)| statistic over 768 NSIDE=8 pixel-center directions
headline_figures.reproduce_command: Set torch + numpy seeds to 42, load catalog_production.parquet (CW/CCW only, n=3,201,160), compute hemisphere matrix at NSIDE=8 (768 directions), run 10000 GPU-batched label-shuffle nulls in batches of 100, take max over 768 directions per null, count nulls with max>=A_obs; result is p_LEE upper bound at the 1/(N_MC+1) ~ 1e-4 precision floor.

headline_figures.figure: Real-space dipole pre-TTA 2.31 sigma + post-TTA 0.43 sigma equivariant residual
headline_figures.abstract_role: Real-space dipole-amplitude collapse via test-time equivariant averaging
headline_figures.method: 1000 per-pixel CW-label permutation nulls at NSIDE=64; dipole amplitude fitted to per-pixel A_p = (N_CW - N_CCW) / (N_CW + N_CCW); pre-TTA and post-TTA computed against the same null distribution

result.post_tta_note: Pre-TTA dipole — see post-TTA 0.43 sigma result in paper Table I

reproducibility.rebuild_note: Original run crashed during json.dump (bool serialization bug). Rebuilt 2026-04-17 from dipolar_analysis.log — all numerical values are verbatim from the log; no re-computation was performed. This is the PRE-TTA pipeline run (2.31 sigma). The paper headline 0.43 sigma is the POST-TTA equivariant correction, tracked separately in Tables I–III of chirality_catalog_paper.tex §V.
reproducibility.caveat: The pre-TTA dipolar_analysis.py script is a pod snapshot; the canonical 0.43-sigma post-TTA value comes from the TTA equivariant pass tracked in §V Tables I-III of the paper rather than from this JSON, which is the pre-TTA 2.31-sigma value. An end-to-end re-execution requires the pod snapshot at /root/experiments/.

headline_figures.figure: Post-MASTER pseudo-C_l dipole -0.122 sigma at l=1
headline_figures.method: NaMaster pseudo-C_l estimator at NSIDE=64, f_sky=0.4928, mode-coupling matrix M_ll' inverted to project pre-deconvolution +6.48-sigma pseudo-C_l peak at l=1 onto deconvolved -0.122-sigma canonical statistic

reproducibility.note: Full MASTER pipeline run details (random seed, null method, NaMaster workspace parameters) are in master_power_spectrum.json metadata. The canonical-N MASTER recompute at N_spiral=3,201,160 / f_sky=0.491 is GPT-B2 deferred (compute-bound; pymaster install on Mac unresolved). The present -0.122-sigma is reported at the analysis subsample n=5,547,858 / f_sky=0.659; this is disclosed in the §V text and in Table III.
